address: North Bovey, Dartmoor National Park, Devon,TQ13 8RE
bio: Located in Dartmoor National Park just 45 minutes from Exeter is Bovey Castle, named as one of the top six places to have Afternoon Tea in the UK by Red Magazine.  The House was built in 1890 as a country retreat in a lavish neo-Elizabethan style. The interior boats a Jacobean style staircase, an oak panelled dining room and a banqueting hall with minstrel's gallery.  Enjoy Afternoon Tea in the dining room or on the terrace overlooking the gardens which includes warm scones, delicate finger sandwiches, delicious homemade cakes and a selection of teas.
